in_marathi.name: Nikhilraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the World
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nikhilraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nikhilraj is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of the World'. It is a revered name in Hindu mythology, representing the supreme power and authority. In various Hindu texts, it is mentioned as the name of several gods, including Vishnu, Shiva, and Indra.
